title: bdk evidence coverage --json
description: Measure the coverage of the lines the Change added from a test tool's coverage report, and record it with the computed verdict.

min.description: The entry's `coverage.min`; null when it only reports.

percent.description: Covered added lines over instrumented added lines, rounded down to one decimal; null when none is instrumented.

total.description: The added lines the report instruments.

items.description: Path relative to the project root.

unmeasured.description: Changed executable files the report does not name; not in `total`.

verdict.description: `fail` only when `min` is set, `total` is above 0 and `percent` is below `min`.
